cases.prompt: Write a PRD for letting tenant admins export invoices to CSV.
expected: Asks <= 5 framing questions with defaults in one round
PRD first line states outcome and the metric it moves; baseline marked to be baselined with owner if unknown
>= 3 non-goals; stories with Given/When/Then incl. permission-denied case
v1 scope small enough for one spec-to-plan plan; v1.1 and later listed
Engineering handoff section lists criteria, entities, RBAC rows, flag name, metric events
No invented customer names or numbers

cases.prompt: Here is our existing PRD for exports (pasted). Tighten it.
expected: Keeps the storyline; applies [KEEP]/[SHARPEN]/[CUT]/[ADD]/[TBD] redlines section by section
Adds missing metrics/non-goals rather than rewriting the narrative
Flags unsourced numbers as [TBD] with owner
Asks once for the problem, persona and success metric
Does not draft a PRD on guesses
